name: Rain Pane
summary: A misted window on a rainy evening: wipe the glass, draw in the mist and count the thunder
about: A cosy window with fairy lights, a cat on the sill and a glass of chai looks out on a rainy street with glowing lamps, cars and a rickshaw. Raindrops gather on the glass, merge and race down, each one holding a tiny upside-down view of the street, while the mist you wipe away slowly creeps back. Good for a cosy cafe or bookshop page, a monsoon sale or a calm hero section.
how: Drag across the glass to wipe the mist away; it slowly fogs up again. On a keyboard, focus the glass and use the arrow keys.
Press Draw a heart (then a smile or a star): a fingertip draws it in the mist and the lines drip.
Press Thunder: lightning flashes, the seconds are counted, then the boom shakes the window and knocks drops loose.
Pick Drizzle, Rain or Downpour to change how fast the drops gather and slide.
With reduced motion there is no shaking, softer lightning and slower drops.
